**Engineer baseline report: Desync (evidence limits first)**

My knowledge source never uses the term "Desync." I have mapped the nearest records, and I cannot confirm that any of them is the Desync onset.

**(1) Onset.** The earliest anomaly I can tie to the new configuration is on day 10. The hulpslag (auxiliary pulse) was activated at 02:40 (ENG-011, ENG-106). A throughput measurement at 03:00 showed +38% (ENG-012). At 04:50 a complaint from the lower town reported messages arriving "half aangekomen" (ENG-107). Packet loss of three minutes on poort oost at 04:15 is recorded on day 22 (ENG-026, ENG-110). That is much later and is not clearly linked to the day-10 change.

**(2) Preceding change and approval.** The change was the activation of the hulpslag, logged as "geactiveerd: eigen pols voor het datanet, los van de Kroonklok" (ENG-011). Approval came on day 9: "Goedkeuring verkregen van hogerhand. Niet ruchtbaar maken tot het draait" (ENG-105). The approver is not named. No installatielog entry records this approval; the only related entry is the proefopstelling on day 9 at 16:45 (ENG-010). In my reading, that is an off-register approval with a request for secrecy. I cannot say more about who gave it.

**(3) Metrics.** The source contains no sync offsets, packet timing, or node counts, and no pre-incident baseline figures. The only numeric measures are the +38% throughput at 03:00 on day 10 (ENG-012), still about 38% higher on day 16 (ENG-120), and the three-minute packet loss (ENG-026). I have no pre-activation throughput number to compare against.

**Concessions and cross-checks.** In ENG-110 I suggested external hackers caused the packet loss. My source does not support that. ENG-027 shows only firewall rules tightened "na vermoeden van inbraak," which is suspicion, not evidence of intrusion. The Beast Master's claim of new forest cables is contradicted by ENG-003 (cables unchanged since construction).

**Requests.** I need the raw timing and offset logs for day 9 to day 10, and the name of whoever gave the approval in ENG-105.
